evals.prompt: Can you audit our iOS app's Mapbox integration? We're on MapboxMaps 11.20 with UIKit and a custom style. In MapScreenViewController.viewDidLoad we have `_ = mapView.mapboxMap.onStyleLoaded.observe { [weak self] _ in self?.addStoreLayers() }`, and the store layers sometimes don't show up. We also call `_ = mapView.camera.ease(to: camera, duration: 0.5)` in a few places.
expectations: Identifies the dropped AnyCancelable from onStyleLoaded.observe as the cause: the token cancels the subscription when released, so the observer never fires (MAPSIOS-B-HYGIENE-1)
Recommends storing the token (for example in a Set<AnyCancelable> with .store(in:)) for as long as the observer should live
Does not flag the discarded Cancelable from camera.ease, since that plain Cancelable doesn't cancel when released
Reports findings in the output schema with File:line, the matching ID, confidence and false-positive risk
Does not recommend switching to Mapbox Standard, since the app uses a custom style

evals.prompt: Review this from our iOS app (MapboxMaps 11.22, UIKit, custom style). Every time the store list refreshes we call `func show(_ stores: [Store]) { let manager = mapView.annotations.makePointAnnotationManager(); for s in stores { var a = PointAnnotation(coordinate: s.coordinate); a.image = .init(image: pinImage, name: "pin-\(s.id)"); manager.annotations.append(a) } }`. Memory keeps growing while users browse.
expectations: Flags creating a new point annotation manager on every refresh as MAPSIOS-B-ANNOT-1: the default id is random, so each call adds a new source and layer that stay until removeAnnotationManager(withId:); create the manager once and keep it in a property
Flags appending to manager.annotations one item at a time as MAPSIOS-B-ANNOT-2 and recommends building the array and assigning it once
Flags the per-store image name ("pin-\(s.id)") for a shared icon as MAPSIOS-B-ANNOT-3: one style image per annotation; use one shared name
Reports each finding in the output schema with the MAPSIOS ID, confidence and false-positive risk, and doesn't change code
